title: Implement task data model and persistence
userStory: As a developer, I want Ralph tasks to store all inputs required for the edit flow so that tasks have complete context for execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Task schema includes: id, title, workspaceId, prompt/instructions, filePaths[], constraints, expectedOutcomes, baseBranch, featureBranch, prTargetBranch, status, taskType, parentId, childIds[], createdAt, updatedAt
Index file tracks all tasks with summary data
CRUD operations via new manager module (lib/managers/ralph-task-manager.ts)
Support for parent/child hierarchy (feature vs story tasks)
